resolution.note: screen.ts shipped; judge agreement with the dev audit is 9/16, below the 12 target

title: D23 units are screened for derivability before any arm runs
body:
Why: the dev derivability audit (2026-11-12, .krn/runs/d23-comparison/n100/dev/regrade) found 6/16 units whose hidden tests assert literals the task never states (N), 7 partly derivable (P), 3 derivable (D); K already passes all 3 D units. Underspecified units are noise no harness can win, so a paired K-vs-P test on them cannot show a difference (SWE-bench Verified filtered the same way).
Outcome: evals/d23/screen.ts classifies each unit D/P/N with a judge model that reads the task text, interface paragraph, the hidden fail-to-pass tests at the merge and the repository at the parent, and writes <out>/<pr>.screen.json {class, reason, evidence}; the judge prompt is fixed in the file; arms never see its output.
Proof: a test with a fake claude asserts the prompt carries task, interface and hidden test text, and the parser rejects a reply without a class; on the 16 dev units the judge agrees with the audit on at least 12.
Scope: evals/d23/, test/evals/.
